classification: SOURCE_FACT + INHERITED_CONTRACT + LABELLED_PRIVATE_SERVER_POLICY (C5C_ONE_ON_ONE_PRIVATE_POLICY_V1), not recovered original-server behaviour where marked
owner: OneOnOne (competition root, player 1 on 1 state, defense teams, offered candidates, promotion state, matches, records, settlements, history facts). Combat, Character, PlayerDisplay, Commerce privilege, I5 Grant/Mail, Achievement and Content keep their ownership.
rules: One competition over all logical servers of the deployment (user decision 2026-10-19). Master holds slots 1..500 and Senior slots 501..5000, each filled contiguously from its first slot; Juniors are ordered by points (ties: earlier reach, then player id). Global rank is the slot for Master/Senior and 5000 + Junior order for Juniors (misc legend_rank_split_bound 5000). Server rank is the position among the player's own logical server in global order. Mutation serializes on the competition root (lock 602) after the actor fence (315) and before Combat (609), I5 Mail (610), Achievement (620) and I5 values (700+).

Times are GMT+8. Ten free tries per day reset at 05:00 (legend_free_num). START is admitted only 08:00-22:00 (legend_start 28800, legend_stop 79200) every day including Sunday (message 30002 'opens from 8:00 to 22:00 everyday'; truce day 7 has no current client consumer; user decision 2026-10-19); outside it START answers in-band error_code 30002.

Function 16 opens at player level 55 (client FunctionOpenTable type 6) with at least 15 owned girls (function tip); the owner checks both at entry. A new entrant joins Junior 3 with 4300 points (legend_point_convert_min_point). Junior level follows points: Junior 1 >= 4850, Junior 2 >= 4650, Junior 3 below (legend_arena_rank rank_bound).

Teams: Master 7, Senior 5, Junior 3 (team_num); each team 1..5 distinct heroes and an optional pet; heroes and pets are unique across a player's teams. PEAK_CHANGE_TEAMS saves exactly the required count. GET_ENEMY_TEAM hides the defender's last team_hide teams (Master 3, Senior 2).

PEAK_START_FIGHT runs best of 3/5/7 by the defender's team count: attacker team i fights defender team i, stopping at a majority; battle 114001 under engine campaign SUPER_ARENA 65 (timeout: more alive wins, then attacker damage >= defender damage). A defender team missing because the defender's group grew is forfeited (attacker wins that round, empty report). Each round is one Combat attempt frozen in the START transaction; rounds resolve outside locks and the match settles once in a terminal transaction before the response returns report_keys, wins, is_win, rank_info and base_info.

Master/Senior: a won match swaps slots when the defender holds a better slot; points do not change. Junior: points move by Elo with misc legend_elo1..4 read as divisor 400, win score 1, base 10, K 20 (STRONG_INFERENCE; user recollection 10-20 per win): gain = round(20 * (1 - 1/(1+10^((Pd-Pa)/400)))), the loser loses the same, floor 3000 (legend_lower_limit).

Cooldown after a normal match: Junior 60 s, Senior/Master 300 s (cool_time); paid reset misc top_refresh_cost 50 crystal when vip.top_reset == 1 or a monthly card is active. Buying tries: only at 0 tries, at most vip.num_top per day, cost refresh_cost.buy_top_cost[n], restores 10.

Rewards: Wednesday and Sunday 22:00 GMT+8 settle once from the competition as of 22:00 (settle-before-mutate plus worker reconcile). Each player with a server rank in legend_reward range gets one mail (LEGEND_MAIL_TITLE/TEXT/SENDER, daily_diamond crystal, daily_mana mana, daily_top_coin top_coin, daily_item x daily_item_num); server rank 1's frame 120001005 travels once per player in its own mail. Scores and ranks are not reset.

Promotion: Friday 21:00 to Saturday 21:00 GMT+8 (legend_promo_start_time/end_time). At open, vacancies fill first (user decision 2026-10-19): the best Seniors among the top 100 fill empty Master slots, then the best Junior 1 players among the top 1000 fill empty Senior slots. Remaining eligible players enter promotion mode (base_info.mode 2) when the upper group is full: three deterministic candidates from the upper group's last 300 Master / last 3000 Senior; the first promotion START locks one; 3 chances, 2 wins promote (legend_promo_chance/win); 1 h cooldown (legend_promote_cool_time); success swaps slot and points with the opponent as they stand at success. Promotion matches do not use daily tries.

Titles at the Sunday settlement by global rank: 1 -> 100002, 2-100 -> 100003, 501 -> 100004, 502-600 -> 100005 (title_system type 2), 604800 s, offered to PlayerDisplay as title origins; LEGEND_KUAFU_MAIL notifies. legend_kuafu_gift (all zero) and legend_kuafu_reward (frames absent from avatar.lua, no consumer) are inactive.

Achievement 100002: consecutive Sunday settlements with server rank <= 3 form a streak; tiers at 1/2/3 weeks; never revoked. Achievement 100028: consecutive won attack matches in normal or promotion mode; tiers at 5/15/30; an attack loss resets; defense results do not count.

Private policy C5C_ONE_ON_ONE_PRIVATE_POLICY_V1 (labelled, versioned): candidate selection = three better-ranked members of the player's own group from bands [p1,p2),[p2,p3),[p3,p4) of the in-group rank with legend_match_param 0.3/0.5/0.98/1 (0.5/0.75/0.95/1 at global rank <= 200), deterministic per player/day/refresh, free refresh; players without a saved defense are not offered; forfeit of missing defense teams; vacancy fill; title delivery at the Sunday settlement only; streak counting rules; match result stops at majority; history window lifetime from producer start (matches count for both sides, per-partner usage per round for own heroes); records keep the last 20 per player (legend_record_num) and a report answers while a retained record references it.

Wire shapes follow src_64 PeakArena.lua, PeakArenaWindow, ChangeEnemyWindow, SelectPeakTeamWindow, PeakArenaReportWindow, NewArenaRecordWindow (SUPER_ARENA) and NewRankWindow (rank_types 3 global, 4 server). Old Peak MIDs 560-571, misc top_start/top_stop, top_robot*, top_reward and PEAK_FIGHT_RESULT stay inactive (PASS421 OLD_PEAK_LEGACY).

Content: a pinned one_on_one catalog compiled from legend_arena_rank, legend_reward, misc legend_* and top_refresh_cost, vip num_top/top_reset, refresh_cost buy_top_cost; top_coin becomes an ENABLED_R4 scalar currency because OneOnOne is its income owner. The 1829 history projection and the exchange shop stay unactivated.
